items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Then after that, I went with Booker Coleman.

ctx.x: In Northwest. What was that band into and how long did that job last?

I stayed with him for about a year. Then the man folded the club up. The club folded up. Then after that, I went with Booker Coleman. I went up to a club around here called the Hanger Club. That's out there right across the Fourteenth Street Bridge. There used to be an airport there, years ago.
You mean out there by the South Capitol Street Bridge, out by where Bowling Air Force Base used to be?
